description: This file defines the interface CustomerOptionValueDao for data access operations related to CustomerOptionValue entities, including methods to list options by store and language, and to retrieve by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDao
classes.description: Java interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao for CustomerOptionValue entities, providing data access methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue object based on the store and option value code.
